units: Ber. I, 1 (Y. a. Bab. ed. בעֲרָבִין). Ib. 9ᵇ גאולה של ע׳ the section on redemption in the evening prayer; תפלה של ע׳ the Prayer of Benedictions in the evening prayer; a. v. fr.—(Adv.) at evening.
Sabb. 118ᵃ קערות שאכל בהן ע׳ dishes which have been used at the (Sabbath) evening meal; a. fr.—Pl. עַרְבִיּוֹת (v. עֶרֶב) the eves of Sabbaths, Holy Days &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 41a:9">Erub. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>משלימין בו ע׳</he> we fast the entire day preceding.
